scripts.check: npm run node:check && npm --prefix packages/ui run check && npm --prefix apps/hub run check

scripts.test:build:hub: npm run node:check && npm --prefix apps/hub run test:build
scripts.test:fast: npm run node:check && npm run lint && npm run test:core
scripts.test:full: npm run test:fast && npm run test:build:hub && npm run test:preview:hub && npm run test:production && npm run test:integration && npm run audit:deps
scripts.test:production: npm run node:check && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/docker-build-context.test.ts tests/hub-adapter-node.test.ts tests/production-image-smoke-build.integration.test.ts
